verdict.rationale: Shortwave is a SaaS email client, so a headless API or CLI for automation is a fair axis. The evidence only shows automations that run inside the app (triggers, AI filters, a Tasklet integration) and MCP client connections, none of which is a headless or CI execution mode. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, and no documentation of a CLI, API or headless mode.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
